newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu 7,744 to dollar for Feb 20 - BNR.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu 7,744 to dollar for Feb 20 - BNR.

text.p: Romania's National Bank (BNR) announced the leu's reference rate weaker at 7,744 to the dollar for February 20.
The reference rate set on Tuesday is a weighted average based on daily reports of foreign exchange operators. It is a guidance rate used for statistical accounting purposes.
The leu's reference rate set on Monday for February 19 is 7,286 to the dollar. It was 7,024 on Tuesday. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
